title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 14
paragraphs: Then Darius wrote a letter to Megabazus, whom he had left to command his army in Thrace, ordering him to remove the Paeonians from their homeland and bring them to the king, both themselves and their children and their wives. A horseman at once set off to ride in haste bearing the message to the Hellespont; and having crossed over, he handed the paper to Megabazus. Having read it and obtained guides from Thrace, he set off to march upon Paeonia.
